# Osso Export Classifier

> A free web tool that classifies a product or technology against Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821, the EU dual-use control list, and shows which export authorisation applies. Every result quotes the regulation word for word. Not legal advice: results must be reviewed by a qualified professional.

Live at https://osso.global/. Run by OSSO GLOBAL TECH, S.L. (Madrid, Spain), built by Ricardo Álvarez-Ossorio Castro. The classifier's code is proprietary; the page and the benchmark are public.

## What it does

- You describe a product in plain words and answer a few questions from its datasheet, such as a frequency, a resolution, a depth rating or an output power.
- The result is one of three outcomes: listed, not listed, or needs expert review. When the description does not settle the question, it says so and shows what to check instead of guessing.
- Each provision the answer rests on is quoted verbatim from the consolidated regulation, and every quote is checked against the text of Annex I by code before the result is shown.
- The card names the export authorisation that applies, including whether a Union General Export Authorisation (EU001 to EU008) is available for the destination. That licensing step is decided by code from tables of the regulation, not by the AI model.
- A memo of the case can be downloaded.
- All of Annex I (384 entries) can be browsed and searched without starting a chat.
- Free: 5 chats a day per visitor. No account, no cookies, no analytics.

## How it differs from a list lookup

A lookup tool finds an entry when you already know its number. This classifier starts from a description of the product, asks only for the figures the control list turns on, and ends on a classification with the provisions quoted. The Annex I text it uses is kept current by Osso Export Watch, which tracks every change to the list.

## Accuracy

- [Benchmark](https://osso.global/benchmark/benchmark.md): 100 products, the method, every case with its expected answer, and every run. The latest run got 92 of 100 right; the 8 misses were all "needs expert review" where a definite answer was expected, and none was a wrong listed or not-listed result.
- [Known failures](https://osso.global/benchmark/known-failures.md): every miss and what was done about it.
- [Threshold tables](https://osso.global/benchmark/tables.md): the product families where fixed thresholds from the regulation decide the answer, with an example question and case for each.

## Common questions

- What is a dual-use item? An item that can be used for both civilian and military purposes. Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821 lists them by category, from nuclear materials to information security.
- Is it free? Yes. There are 5 free chats a day, and browsing the whole of Annex I needs no chat.
- Is it legal advice? No. Every result must be reviewed by a qualified professional before it is relied on.

## Related

- [Osso Export Watch](https://watch.osso.global/): tracks changes to the EU dual-use list and to US and EU export controls.
- [Regulation (EU) 2021/821 on EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/821/oj)
- [Privacy](https://osso.global/privacy.html) and [terms](https://osso.global/terms.html).
